name: C. H. Robinson Worldwide, Inc.
moat_justification: Largest US freight broker with a two-sided shipper/carrier network, Navisphere data scale and Lean AI productivity (+60% since end-2022, 13 straight quarters outgrowing the Cass index); ROIC proxy stayed 14.3%-32.8% over FY2020-25, above cost of capital even at the 2023 trough. But shippers and carriers multi-home with low switching costs, supply is not owned, pricing is transparent and the business is freight-cycle exposed, so the moat is moderate, not wide.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.2x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: High-quality asset-light freight broker, moat 6/10 — does not clear 15% at $139.95 on any scenario (weighted IRR 6.59%, weighted IV@15% $44.06; even super bull is 10.98% / $89.90); it clears 15% only at or below $44.06.
moat_for: Scale network: largest US freight broker, tens of thousands of shippers and carriers, volume/data advantage in matching and pricing
ROIC proxy 14.3%-32.8% FY2020-25 (fundamentals.json), above cost of capital through the freight trough
Lean AI productivity: >60% improvement since end-2022 in NAST and Global Forwarding, headcount down while volumes rose; 13 straight quarters outgrowing the Cass Freight Shipment Index
Asset-light variable-cost model: capex only $19.6M in FY2025 against $914.5M OCF, profitability cushioned in downturns
moat_against: Low switching costs: shippers deliberately multi-home brokers in routing guides and carriers are not owned or exclusive
Fragmented, transparent-priced brokerage: TQL, RXO, J.B. Hunt, Echo/Uber Freight and digital/AI entrants compete on the same capacity pool
Freight cyclicality: revenue fell from $24.70B (FY2022) to $16.23B (FY2025) and OE/share spans -0.52 to 11.78 over the last five years
Montgomery negligent-hiring legal exposure for brokers plus the pending RXO acquisition (integration, leverage and customer-overlap risk)
